title: UnidentifiedSignon
description: An unidentified signon attempt where the provided username does not correspond to any valid Workday account. These records are used for monitoring potential unauthorized access attempts.

id.description: Unique identifier for the unidentified signon event

attemptedUsername.description: The username that was provided during the signon attempt but did not match any valid Workday account

signonDateTime.description: Timestamp when the signon attempt occurred

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the signon attempt originated

browserType.description: Browser type used for the signon attempt

operatingSystem.description: Operating system of the device used for the signon attempt

deviceType.description: Type of device used for the signon attempt
